title: Handle a known failure
summary: Spring Boot: Handle a known failure. Change the public message.
introduction: @ExceptionHandler formats one error type for this controller. Open GET /broken.
learningObjectives: Handle a known failure with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Handle a known failure

blocks.text: The controller handler catches the declared exception type and replaces it with a controlled 500 reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not expose private stack traces or internal values in error replies.

seo.title: Spring Boot: Handle a known failure
seo.description: Spring Boot: Handle a known failure. Change the public message. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
